Description
This function is used to prepare a key update operation. The main intent is to provide
information for the key operation to the key server. Other operations may start the negotiation
for a common secret that is used further to derive key material. This function is only available if
KeyMCryptoKeyPrepareFunctionEnabled is set to TRUE.
